key_points: S&P 500 posted historic point gain after 7 straight losing days, but commentary warns such rallies often precede further volatility
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reinstated with stock surging 31%, providing significant boost to ~6-7% index weight
ETF flows show net buying across major SPY components (Apple, Meta, Alphabet, Costco, Walmart, Intel)
Hedge fund activity mixed on AI names per Goldman: cutting Alphabet/AMD, adding Intel/Meta
Options data shows heavy put and call activity indicating hedging/speculation rather than directional conviction
